test_self_cycle: test that a pybind11 object with a self-referential cycle is garbage collected correctly
test_indirect_cycle: test that a pybind11 object with an indirect cycle through a list is garbage collected
gc_tester_fixture: use the gc_tester pytest fixture to verify an object is garbage collected via weak references
review_OwnsPythonObjects: review the pybind11 OwnsPythonObjects class to understand how it manages Python object ownership
run_custom_type_setup_tests: run the pybind11 custom type setup tests to verify garbage collection of C++ objects owning Python objects
